channel.title: Religion News Service - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Religion News Service (religionnews.com)

item.title: Leftover ramen, too few Qurans: A ‘humiliating’ Ramadan inside ICE detention centers
item.description: ICE is required to accommodate religious practice. Muslim detainees say that this Ramadan, it comes down to whoever is on shift. 'You are basically at the mercy of staff.'

item.title: Women of the Rosenstrasse protest challenged the Nazi regime for their detained Jewish husbands’ freedom – and won
item.description: Couples in interfaith marriages came under intense pressure in Nazi Germany. But women’s protests in February 1943 may have helped save their husbands.

item.title: Notions of ‘Christendom’ often miss the mark – medieval Europe’s ideas about faith and power were not so simple
item.description: There has never been a singular Christian perspective on how religion, power and politics ought to relate to each other – not even in medieval ‘Christendom.’

item.title: Iran targets busiest international airport as top UN body demands halt to attacks on Gulf neighbors
item.description: The latest attacks marked an escalation in the Islamic Republic's campaign aimed at generating enough global economic pain to pressure the United States and Israel to end the war that started 12 days ago. But there were no signs that the conflict was letting up.

item.title: Iran war has blocked the Strait of Hormuz, a vital oil choke point. Reopening it is a big challenge
item.description: Former naval officers who have served in the Hormuz passage say vessels would be sitting ducks, with little room for maneuver in the strait's narrow shipping lanes, if foreign naval forces attempted to reopen the waterway before a cessation of hostilities.

item.title: Suspect in Michigan synagogue attack is dead, AP source says
item.description: WEST BLOOMFIELD, Mich. (AP) — FBI Director Kash Patel said agents are on scene of an “apparent vehicle ramming and active shooter situation” at the synagogue.

item.title: In Trump’s Iran conflict, it’s prosperity gospel vs. the Quran
item.description: Opposing philosophies, distilled from two ancient sacred texts, are colliding in horrific ways.

item.title: US-Syria Business Council, the Atlantic Council to convene US-Syria Energy Symposium on March 26
Fitness meets faith as religious coaches and influencers reshape wellness culture
item.description: Around the world, Muslim, Jewish, Sikh, Hindu and Buddhist coaches and influencers are creating their own faith-based platforms for fitness.

item.title: Oscar-nominated ‘Forevergreen’ reimagines story of Christian grace
item.description: minute short film was created by Disney veterans and brought to life by over 200 volunteers.
